name: @openmd/obsidian
description: openmd for Obsidian: renders ```openui blocks in notes as live UI.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.tsx --bundle --format=cjs --platform=browser --target=es2022 --minify --external:obsidian --external:electron --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --outfile=dist/main.js && cat dist/main.css styles.css > dist/styles.css && rm dist/main.css && cp manifest.json dist/
scripts.install-vault: npm run build && mkdir -p ../../example-vault/.obsidian/plugins/openmd && cp dist/main.js dist/styles.css dist/manifest.json ../../example-vault/.obsidian/plugins/openmd/
